category: Lipi — the script and its orthography
label: the akṣara: the syllable is the unit Devanagari is built from
note: Spanish asks for syllable division. Devanagari's unit is the akṣara — a consonant with its vowel — and the virāma is what strips the inherent vowel so two consonants can bind. The track teaches the virāma in chapter 1. CONJUNCT CONSONANTS as a written form are not taught systematically, which is the real gap behind this point.
